A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their complete main text and Appendices A–B are readable, and the equations, seven tables, and four figures can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v2 reports original model evaluations and ablations, qualitative comparisons, and a human/Gemini assessment of generated descriptions in Appendix A.4.

after.justification: v5 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, qualitative comparisons, and description-quality assessment, including the appendix results.

M1.justification: The hierarchical frame/clip/video alignment, frozen text encoder, counterfactual generation procedures, and training objectives remain unchanged. The generator-version correction agrees with v2's appendix and does not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both retain Ego4D/EgoClip pretraining and the same six downstream tasks using GTEA, EgoPER, Epic-Kitchens, Charades-Ego, and Align-Ego-Exo. Appendix action coverage and description-quality evaluation are unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods. Br-prompt remains in the GTEA comparison; I3D and HierVL remain in the long-video evaluations; CLIP, MIL-NCE, and PVRL remain in retrieval/classification comparisons. The ablation and qualitative comparator sets also match.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 corrects the stated generator from Llama 3.2 8B to Llama 3.1 8B, matching Appendix A in both versions. This is a reported setting correction, without evidence of rerunning experiments. Other settings remain unchanged; the expanded Charades-Ego discussion retains the PT-checkpoint choice already stated in v2's Table 3 caption.

E4.justification: v5 removes Section 3.3's brief comparison of joint versus decoupled summary/counterfactual losses, which v2 reported as showing no noticeable performance difference. Table 5's component ablations, Appendix A.4's quality assessment, and Appendix B's qualitative analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 5 retains mean ± standard deviation reporting for five GTEA runs and ten EgoPER runs. No seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty-reporting practices are added or removed.

E6.justification: Numerical results in Tables 1–7 and Appendix A.4 are unchanged. v5 removes the unquantified joint-versus-decoupled-loss finding in Section 3.3. Section 4.6 also removes the F1/Edit qualification from the ID 3 GTEA finding; Table 5 reports accuracy for that task.

T1.justification: The mathematical objectives and reasoning are retained. Equation 3 changes summation labels from p/n to z_p/z_n to match the sample notation, without changing the loss. No substantive definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: Both versions claim that hierarchical learning with state-change descriptions and counterfactuals improves procedure awareness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on several tasks. The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same scientific scope.

C2.justification: Section 4.5 completes the conjectured explanation of CLIP's performance by connecting its short-term focus to image-to-text alignment. Section 2 more cautiously frames prior-method overfitting and counterfactual necessity. Appendix A.4's limitation concerning low-probability counterfactuals remains unchanged.

D1.justification: v5 replaces the promised future code/data release with a code-availability statement and repository address. It resolves the Llama-version inconsistency and expands the explanation of Charades-Ego checkpoint selection. Hardware, training hyperparameters, generation prompts, and appendix processing instructions otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2.3 removes the Stable Diffusion example and its Rombach et al. latent-diffusion reference, numbered 59 in v2. The broader positioning against procedure-learning, state-change, and counterfactual research remains intact.

P1.justification: v5 predominantly makes local copyedits, compresses repetitive introductory and methodological passages, standardizes counterfactual terminology, and updates author and acknowledgment text. The section organization and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 3 moves from page 8 to page 7, Tables 4–5 are repositioned, and several captions are revised, including explicit bold/underline explanations. All four figure graphics and the underlying table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v5 improves clarity and reproducibility documentation by resolving the Llama-version inconsistency, explaining checkpoint selection, completing a broken interpretation sentence, and providing a code reference. It also removes references to F1/Edit results absent from the ablation table. Removing the unquantified loss comparison slightly reduces supporting detail, but the unchanged quantitative evidence and these focused corrections support a limited overall improvement.
